{{Quote|Isn't that the ship that wiped out Arnod's flight back in the asteroid field? The one from the Battle of Yavin?|Rignik, referring to the ''Millennium Falcon''|<ref name="DVT" />}}
[[Flight Lieutenant]] '''Rignik''' was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[TIE pilot]] who flew a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Occupation of Bespin|occupied]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], Rignik was among the [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] initially patrolling outside the planet who escorted [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|craft]] [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']] as it left the planet. The pilots then received new orders to pursue the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], which was attempting to escape Bespin.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Back off.|Boba Fett, to Rignik and the other TIE pilots|<ref name="DVT" />}}
Rignik was a [[TIE pilot]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] by<ref name="DVT" /> [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Rignik flew a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] and was a [[Flight Lieutenant]] reporting to [[Flight Commander/Legends|Flight Commander]] [[Mallop]].<ref name="DVT" /> In 3 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Occupation of Bespin|occupied]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] with the intention to capture the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] associated with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="NEC" /> When [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], who had aided the Empire during Bespin's occupation, left the planet aboard his [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|''Firespray-31''-class patrol and attack craft]], the [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']], Rignik and Mallop were among the four [[TIE series/Legends|TIE/LN]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]&mdash;initially on a routine patrol&mdash;who approached the [[Starship/Legends|craft]] as it headed towards the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']] outside Bespin.<ref name="DVT" />

[[File:RarrExecutorSMASH-ESBHD.jpg|thumb|right|320px|The ''Millennium Falcon'' escaping its TIE fighter pursuers]]
Fett warned Rignik and the other pilots to slow down when their TIE/LN starfighters matched the speed of ''Slave I'', and the TIE pilots continued following the ship only at maximum range before it jumped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. The pilots' subsequent return to their normal patrol routes was very short-lived, for the group received new orders to pursue the ''Millennium Falcon'' as it was approaching them from Bespin.<ref name="DVT" />

Rignik nervously asked about the ''Falcon''{{'s}} history of wiping out TIE pilot [[Arnod (Galactic Empire)|Arnod]]'s flight in the [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|Hoth asteroid field]] as well as the ship's involvement in the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] before being admonished by Mallop.<ref name="DVT" /> Ultimately, TIE/LN starfighters from the Imperial [[Obsidian Squadron/Legends|Obsidian Squadron]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|402|Obsidian Squadron}}</ref> pursued the ''Falcon'' out of Bespin and into [[Realspace/Legends|space]] before the [[Light freighter/Legends|freighter]] escaped Imperial clutches.<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You're on report the moment we land!|Mallop, disciplining Rignik as a result of the latter's inquiry about the ''Millennium Falcon''|<ref name="DVT" />}}
Rignik and the other TIE pilots were relieved when Boba Fett's ''Slave I'' jumped into hyperspace, although their break was short-lived as they had to pursue the ''Millennium Falcon''. Rignik's nervous inquiry about the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] prompted Mallop to reprimand the Flight Lieutenant, with Rignik being told about being on report upon landing.<ref name="DVT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rignik was created by author [[Michael Stern]] for "[[Dark Voyage to Tatooine]]," a short story published in [[West End Games]]' [[1990]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi]]''.<ref name="DVT" />
